gloss: to prepare; to get ready; to make preparations

definitions.gloss: to prepare; to get ready; to make preparations
definitions.explanation: To arrange or organize things in advance so that one is ready for a future event, task, or situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I prepared the materials for tomorrow's meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{非常食|ひじょうしょく}→非常食：18765_hijoushoku⟧や⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{準備|じゅんび}しておいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should prepare emergency food and water in case of a disaster.

notes:
One of the most frequently used verbs in daily Japanese. Used broadly for any kind of advance preparation, from packing for a trip to setting up a meeting room. Often takes the pattern ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle) as well as {準備|じゅんび}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: preparations are complete
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be ready
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}{不足|ぶそく}→準備不足：27105_junbibusoku⟧: lack of preparation
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: preparation period
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: mental preparation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare / to arrange — focuses on having things ready and at hand; more concrete and immediate
- ⟦{支度|したく}する→支度する：01828_shitakusuru⟧: to get ready — focuses on personal preparation like getting dressed or packing
- ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for / to provide against — emphasizes precaution against future events

USAGE:
{準備|じゅんび}する is the most general and versatile preparation verb. It works for both concrete tasks (preparing materials) and abstract contexts (preparing mentally). ⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ is more about having specific items ready, while {準備|じゅんび}する covers the broader process of getting ready.
